modelSection.title: Model & threshold
modelSection.desc: Global default model & threshold (written to ~/.config/openkb/global.yaml; each KB can inherit or override in its own settings)

credSection.title: Default credentials
credSection.desc: Global default API credentials (written to ~/.config/openkb/.env; a KB's own .env and process env vars take precedence)
credSection.clearPending: Marked for removal; takes effect on save

general.langDesc: The output language written into the compile prompt, e.g. en / 中文 / 日本語
general.kbRootDesc: Default location for new knowledge bases (<root>/<name>); leave empty to restore the built-in default. Individual KBs can set a custom path at creation.
general.kbRootEnvPinned: Pinned by the OPENKB_KB_ROOT environment variable; edits here won't take effect until it's unset.

conn.note: Cloud data-source connectors (OAuth / S3) are in development and not yet available; for now, upload local files from the KB detail page. Want a connector? Click a card below to vote on GitHub and help us prioritize.

about.blurb: Compile raw documents into a structured, cross-linked wiki-style knowledge base, powered by PageIndex's vectorless, reasoning-based long-document retrieval.
about.byline: Built by Vectify AI · part of the PageIndex product line
